From the owner
A full condo on the 40th floor, and the painting went from two rooms to every room. That change came mid-project, in writing, priced and signed before anyone picked up a brush. It is the part of a remodel people dread, and it does not have to be dramatic: you see the number, you approve it or you don't, and the schedule already had the days in it. Kitchen, bathrooms and now paint throughout, in a Streeterville high-rise with building approval and trade insurance certificates in hand before demolition. Fixed price in the contract before anything is ordered.
Sep 28, 2026

Assembly Squad Remodeling LLC is a licensed design-build general contractor serving Chicago homeowners and condo owners since 2013. We specialize in kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovation, condo gut renovations, basement finishing, and whole home renovations — handling everything from design and permits to construction and final walkthrough.

With 500+ completed home renovation projects, an A+ BBB rating, and a dedicated design studio in Lincoln Park at 2315 N Southport Ave, we're Chicago's trusted remodeling contractor for kitchens, bathrooms, condos, and complete home transformations. Every project includes a dedicated project manager, fixed-price proposal, full HOA coordination, and a 2-year workmanship warranty.

One Company.
Everything Included.

Assembly Squad is Chicago's boutique design-build general contractor — one licensed team handles every step of your renovation under one roof, one contract, one fixed price.

Most homeowners spend weeks coordinating between an architect, a designer, a general contractor, and a cabinet vendor — each one pointing fingers when things go wrong. We built Assembly Squad to eliminate that entirely. From the first design consultation at our Lincoln Park studio through the final city inspection, you work with one dedicated team and one project manager accountable for everything.

We specialize in kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovation, condo gut renovations, basement finishing, whole-home renovations, attic conversions, and Illinois-made custom cabinetry — serving all Chicago neighborhoods and the North Shore.

View our completed project portfolio, explore our full range of services, or see our Chicago service areas.

OUR STORY
Built in Chicago. Built Different.

From a two-person startup to Chicago's most trusted design-build company — here's how we got here.

2011
The Idea Begins

Viktor Aharon — 22+ years deep in remodeling — builds the first version of Assembly Squad as a mobile app designed to help homeowners navigate the remodeling process more intelligently, giving them a smarter way to plan, budget, and manage their renovation.

2013
Assembly Squad Is Born

The app evolves into something bigger. Assembly Squad officially launches as a boutique design-build general contracting company — IL License #TGC098779, HQ at 205 N Michigan Ave. One team, one contract, one stress-free experience.

2015
Condo Expertise Takes Shape

As Chicago's high-rise condo renovation demand surges, Assembly Squad builds its HOA coordination system — alteration agreements, COI management, board presentations. Pre-approvals begin accumulating. Today that number exceeds 300 buildings.

2019
Recognition & Growth

Assembly Squad earns Best of Houzz, joins NKBA, and achieves its A+ BBB rating. The team completes its 200th Chicago renovation. Specialization deepens across kitchen design-build, historic greystone renovation, and luxury condo gut rehabs.

2024
Illinois-Made Cabinets

Assembly Squad launches its Illinois-made custom cabinetry program — cutting import delays from 16 weeks to 4–6. Better cabinets, faster delivery, zero tariff exposure. No overseas supply chain risk.

2025
Lincoln Park Design Studio Opens

Assembly Squad opens its 2,500 sq ft design-build studio at 2315 N Southport Ave, Lincoln Park. With 500+ curated materials on display — cabinet finishes, countertop slabs, tile, hardware, and flooring — clients work side by side with our experienced design team before a single wall comes down.

2025
Squad to Suburbs

Assembly Squad launches its North Shore expansion — bringing the same boutique design-build experience to Winnetka, Lake Forest, Highland Park, Glencoe, Evanston, and beyond.

TODAY
500+ Projects. Still Building.

13+ years. 500+ completed renovations. 4.9 stars. A+ BBB. NARI Chicago member. EPA Lead-Safe Certified. And the same commitment Viktor started with in 2011 — make Chicago home renovation the way it should always have been: stress-free, transparent, and built to last.

OUR EXPERTISE
Why Chicago Homeowners Choose Assembly Squad

Licensed professionals with specialized expertise in Chicago's unique architectural challenges.

Historic Preservation Specialists

EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm (#NAT-F285417-1) specializing in 1880s–1920s Chicago architecture. We preserve original character while updating plumbing, electrical, and structural systems. Certified under the EPA Renovation, Repair & Painting program — required for work in pre-1978 Chicago homes including greystones and bungalows.

Chicago Permit Experts

All permits and inspections included on every project. Licensed contractor (IL #TGC098779) with direct experience navigating city inspectors across all Chicago neighborhoods. Typical permit processing: 2–3 weeks, factored into every project timeline.

Condo & HOA Specialists

Pre-approved in 300+ Chicago buildings. We navigate HOA alteration agreements, elevator scheduling, insurance certificates, and building management protocols on every condo project. 75% of our completed projects are Chicago condominium renovations. Zero HOA complaints in 13 years.

NKBA & NARI Certified

Certified by the National Kitchen & Bath Association and a member of NARI of Greater Chicagoland. Our designers follow industry best practices for space planning, material selection, and code compliance. View our NKBA profile and NARI Chicago listing.

Viktor Aharon
Founder & CEO
Assembly Squad Remodeling
22+ years in remodeling
FROM THE FOUNDER
Why I Started Assembly Squad

"I wanted to build something genuinely different — a company where Chicago homeowners never have to waste a single hour of their day managing their own renovation."

After more than 22 years working in remodeling, I saw the same frustrations play out over and over. Homeowners juggling multiple contractors, chasing permit updates, making a dozen decisions no one prepared them for — all while trying to live their lives. The process was broken, and it didn't have to be.

Assembly Squad started as an app in 2011 — built specifically to help homeowners navigate the remodeling process more intelligently. By 2013, that idea evolved into a boutique design-build general contracting company built around a single principle. One team handles everything. Design, permits, materials, construction, and final walkthrough — under one contract, one fixed price, one dedicated project manager.

What sets us apart isn't just what we build — it's how we think about why you're building it. Some clients are creating a forever home. Others are planning a 5 to 6 year stay before moving on. Both are valid, and both deserve a smart renovation strategy. We build a plan that balances your enjoyment of the home today with the return you'll see when it's time to sell. You shouldn't have to choose between loving where you live now and protecting your investment later.

That's the company I set out to build in 2013. That's the company we are today.

"Thirteen years in this industry has taught me one thing above everything else — transparency, fairness, and genuinely putting your clients first isn't just the right way to do business. It's the only reason any business lasts."

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about Assembly Squad's credentials, process, and locations.

What makes Assembly Squad different from other Chicago remodeling contractors?
Assembly Squad is a true design-build company — one team handles design, permits, materials, construction, and final walkthrough under a single fixed-price contract. Is Assembly Squad licensed and insured in Illinois?
Yes. IL General Contractor License #TGC098779, $2M liability insurance, A+ BBB. Also an EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm (#NAT-F285417-1), NKBA member, and NARI of Greater Chicagoland member.
Does Assembly Squad handle HOA approvals for condo remodeling?
Yes — HOA coordination is fully included on every condo project. Pre-approved in 300+ Chicago buildings. We handle alteration agreements, COI, architectural drawings, neighbor notifications, and board presentations. 75% of our projects are condo renovations. Zero HOA complaints in 13 years. Call (312) 544-9150.
Is Assembly Squad EPA Lead-Safe Certified?
Yes — EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm, Certification #NAT-F285417-1 under the EPA Renovation, Repair & Painting program. Required for work in pre-1978 homes — directly relevant for Chicago's greystones, bungalows, and vintage two-flats.
Where is the Assembly Squad design studio?
2315 N Southport Ave, Lincoln Park, Chicago IL 60614 — open Mon–Fri 9am–6pm, Sat 10am–4pm, by appointment. 2,500 sq ft showroom with 500+ curated materials — cabinet finishes, countertop slabs, tile, hardware, and flooring — all selected alongside our design team. Free 3D renderings included. HQ at 205 N Michigan Ave, Suite 810. Call (312) 544-9150.
How long has Assembly Squad been in business?
Founded by Viktor Aharon in 2013 — 13+ years in Chicago. 500+ completed projects. 4.9-star Google rating. A+ BBB throughout. WELCOME TO ASSEMBLY SQUAD
Chicago's Full-Service Design-Build Remodeling Company

Since 2013, Assembly Squad Remodeling has been transforming homes across Chicago, the North Shore, and surrounding suburbs. As a licensed general contractor, we handle every aspect of your renovation — from initial design concepts through final construction — so you have one trusted team managing your entire project.

Design Studio
Lincoln Park Showroom
HOW WE WORK
Our 4-Step Process

Every project follows the same proven approach — from your first call to final walkthrough.

01
FREE & NO OBLIGATION
Consultation

We visit your home, discuss your vision, assess the space, and answer all your questions.

02
FIXED-PRICE QUOTE
Design & Proposal

Custom plans with 3D renderings and detailed line-item pricing. No hidden fees.

03
DAILY UPDATES
Construction

Your dedicated project manager keeps everything on track with daily updates.

04
2-YEAR WARRANTY
Completion

Final walkthrough, touch-ups, and your 2-year workmanship warranty.

OUR EXPERTISE
Chicago Home Remodeling Services
MOST POPULAR
Kitchen Remodeling

After remodeling hundreds of Chicago kitchens, we've learned that no two projects are alike. Whether you're working with a galley kitchen in a vintage two-flat or opening up walls in a Lincoln Park brownstone, we design around how you actually cook and live.

Custom cabinetry solutions
Vintage building expertise
Chicago permit handling
Full design-build service
Learn more about kitchen remodeling
HIGH ROI
Bathroom Remodeling

Chicago bathrooms are notoriously small — we get it. Over the years, we've developed real solutions for maximizing tight spaces without sacrificing style. From tub-to-shower conversions to full gut renovations.

Tub-to-shower conversions
Older plumbing expertise
Space-maximizing layouts
All-inclusive pricing
Learn more about bathroom remodeling
ADDED SPACE
Basement Finishing

Finishing a basement in Chicago means dealing with moisture — there's no way around it. We start every project with a thorough assessment and address any water issues before building out walls. Basement remodeling in Chicago runs $55–$140 per square foot, and under the city's new ADU ordinance we can even convert your basement into a legal rental apartment.

Moisture assessment included
Low ceiling solutions
Egress window installation
Basement ADU conversions
Learn more about basement finishing
URBAN LIVING
Condo Remodeling

Renovating a condo in Chicago is a different animal than working on a single-family home. We've worked in buildings throughout the Gold Coast, Streeterville, and River North, so we know the drill.

HOA paperwork handled
Building coordination
High-rise experience
Neighbor-friendly scheduling
Learn more about condo remodeling
COMPLETE
Whole Home Renovation

When you're updating multiple rooms or doing a full gut renovation, having one contractor manage everything makes a real difference. We coordinate all the trades — electrical, plumbing, HVAC, carpentry.

Single point of contact
All trades coordinated
Older home expertise
Detailed project timeline
Learn more about whole home renovation
MADE IN IL
Custom Cabinets

We partner with cabinet manufacturers right here in Illinois, which means shorter lead times and no import tariffs affecting your price. Show us any photo and we can build it.

Made in Illinois
4-6 week lead time
Free 3D renderings
Any style, any room
Learn more about custom cabinets
ADU READY
Attic Conversions

Chicago's bungalows and two-flats often have attics with real potential. We've converted dozens into bedrooms, home offices, playrooms, and legal ADUs that generate rental income.

ADU permit expertise
Structural assessment
Climate-rated insulation
Code-compliant design
Learn more about attic conversions
BUDGET-FRIENDLY
IKEA Kitchen Installation

We've been installing IKEA kitchens since 2013, and honestly, they're a smart choice for many homeowners. The cabinet boxes are solid, and with the right installation, they look custom.

IKEA planning help
Custom panel options
Modification expertise
Professional installation
Learn more about IKEA kitchen installation
VISIT US
Design-Build Showroom

Our 2,500 sq ft Lincoln Park showroom is where your renovation begins. Touch real materials, see full-size cabinet displays, and work with our design team to create 3D renderings of your project — all before construction starts.

Full-size cabinet displays
Countertop & tile samples
Free 3D design renderings
One team: design + build

FREQUENTLY ASKED
Questions about Chicago remodeling

Expert answers about our Chicago kitchen and bathroom remodeling services, costs, timelines, and process.

How much does kitchen remodeling cost in Chicago in 2026?
Kitchen remodeling costs in Chicago for 2026 range from $25,000 to $250,000+ depending on size, materials, and scope. Budget IKEA kitchens start at $15,000–$35,000 (2–3 weeks). Mid-range custom kitchens cost $40,000–$80,000 (4–6 weeks). Luxury custom kitchens with premium finishes range $100,000–$250,000+ (6–12 weeks). Assembly Squad provides transparent itemized pricing with no hidden fees. See our full kitchen remodel cost guide →
How long does a complete home remodel take in Chicago?
Complete whole-home remodels in Chicago typically take 10–16 weeks depending on scope. Kitchen-only remodels: 3–6 weeks. Single bathroom remodels: 2–4 weeks. Multiple-room renovations (kitchen plus 2 bathrooms): 8–12 weeks. Whole-home transformations with structural changes: 12–16 weeks. Our recent Wicker Park whole-home project at 1654 N Oakley completed in 12 weeks — kitchen, 3 bathrooms, entertainment built-ins, hardwood refinishing throughout.
What Chicago neighborhoods does Assembly Squad serve?
Assembly Squad serves all Chicago neighborhoods and North Shore suburbs — Lincoln Park, Gold Coast, Wicker Park, Bucktown, West Loop, River North, Streeterville, Lakeview, Lakeshore East, South Loop, Old Town, Logan Square, Uptown, Andersonville, Hyde Park, West Town, North Park, Little Italy, plus Evanston, Winnetka, Lake Forest, Hinsdale, Highland Park, and Flossmoor. City of Chicago licensed general contractor (TGC098779) serving the Chicago area since 2013 with 500+ completed projects.
Do you remodel Chicago lofts — West Loop, River North, Fulton Market?
Yes — loft remodeling is a specialty for Assembly Squad. We handle warehouse conversion lofts in West Loop and Fulton Market, high-rise open-plan condos in River North and Streeterville, artist lofts in Wicker Park and Bucktown, and adaptive-reuse buildings in Uptown. Loft-specific expertise includes exposed brick kitchen backsplash integration, steel column design work, open ceiling HVAC coordination, and high-ceiling lighting design. See our full Chicago loft remodeling service page →
Does Assembly Squad work on Gold Coast pre-war co-ops and Lake Shore Drive buildings?
Yes — Gold Coast pre-war co-op and Lake Shore Drive renovations are a specialty. Recent work includes the full renovation of a 1929 Robert DeGolyer pre-war co-op at 1242 N Lake Shore Drive, kitchen and bath at 1010 N Lake Shore Drive, and bathroom renovation at 680 N Lake Shore Drive. Direct experience with co-op board approvals, alteration agreements, and preservation of original architectural details.
Does Assembly Squad offer free estimates for Chicago remodeling?
Yes — free in-home consultations and detailed estimates for all kitchen, bathroom, and whole-home remodeling projects throughout Chicago. Estimates include itemized materials cost, labor breakdown, timeline with milestones, permit costs, and 3D design renderings for projects over $40K. Call (312) 544‑9150 or visit our Lincoln Park design studio at 2315 N Southport Ave.
Do you handle permits for Chicago remodeling projects?
Yes — all permits and inspections handled on every project. Assembly Squad manages all permit applications, coordinates electrical, plumbing, and structural inspections, and makes sure the work meets the Chicago Building Code. Review times depend on the permit type, so we submit early and let permits run alongside design and cabinet production. Permit costs are included in our fixed-price proposals.
Does Assembly Squad handle HOA approvals for condo remodeling?
Yes — condo and HOA approvals are handled on every condo project. We prepare alteration agreements, certificates of insurance, architectural drawings and board presentations, and schedule freight elevators with building management. All HOA coordination costs are included in our fixed-price proposals.
Is Assembly Squad licensed and insured in Illinois?
Yes. City of Chicago General Contractor License #TGC098779, fully insured, A+ BBB. Also an EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm (#NAT-F285417-1), NKBA member, and NARI of Greater Chicagoland member. Founded 2013. 13+ years, 500+ completed projects.

Where Does Assembly Squad Remodel?

Assembly Squad Remodeling is a Chicago design-build contractor serving 15 Chicago neighborhoods, 9 North Shore communities and 8 suburbs within about 40 miles of the Loop. Typical budgets run $25,000 to $150,000+ for kitchens, $15,000 to $55,000 for bathrooms, $85,000 to $300,000+ for condo gut renovations and $30,000 to $100,000+ for basements. Every area gets the same free in-home consultation, fixed-price proposal and 2-year workmanship warranty.

Why Chicago Homeowners Choose Assembly Squad

Assembly Squad is a genuine local company, not a national chain with a Chicago phone number. Since 2013 we've built deep knowledge of Chicago's permit offices, building managers, and the architectural quirks that make each community unique.

One team from design through construction. One fixed-price contract, one project manager, one 2-year warranty. We specialize in kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovation, condo gut renovations, basement finishing, whole house remodeling, attic conversions, and Illinois-made custom cabinetry.

Expanding to the North Shore? Our North Shore remodeling hub covers Winnetka, Lake Forest, Highland Park, and beyond. Visit our Lincoln Park design studio or see our completed project portfolio.

FAQ
Service Area FAQs

Common questions about Assembly Squad's service areas across Chicago and suburbs.

Which Chicago neighborhoods does Assembly Squad serve?
Assembly Squad serves 15 Chicago neighborhoods with dedicated service pages. North Side coverage includes Lincoln Park, Lakeview, Roscoe Village, Andersonville and Lake Shore Drive. Downtown covers Gold Coast, River North, Streeterville, The Loop, Old Town and South Loop. West and Northwest Chicago covers West Loop, Logan Square, Wicker Park and Bucktown.
Does Assembly Squad serve North Shore communities like Winnetka and Lake Forest?
Yes. Through its Squad to Suburbs 2026 initiative, Assembly Squad serves nine North Shore communities: Winnetka, Lake Forest, Highland Park, Glencoe, Wilmette, Evanston, Kenilworth, Lake Bluff and Northbrook. Each has a dedicated service page, and North Shore consultations start with an in-home visit or at the Lincoln Park design studio at 2315 N Southport Ave.
Which Chicago suburbs does Assembly Squad serve?
Beyond the North Shore, Assembly Squad serves Arlington Heights, Barrington Hills, South Barrington, Buffalo Grove, Hinsdale, Inverness, Lincolnshire and Glenview. Suburban projects include kitchens, bathrooms, basements and whole-home renovations. Homeowners in other Chicagoland suburbs can call (312) 544-9150 to confirm whether their address falls inside the service area.
How far from Chicago does Assembly Squad work?
Assembly Squad works within roughly 40 miles of the Chicago Loop. That radius reaches north to Lake Forest and Lake Bluff, northwest to Barrington Hills and Inverness, and west to Hinsdale. Every project inside the radius gets the same free in-home consultation, fixed-price proposal and 2-year workmanship warranty as a Chicago project.
Is Assembly Squad a licensed remodeling contractor?
Yes. Assembly Squad Remodeling LLC holds City of Chicago General Contractor License #TGC098779, carries $2M liability insurance, holds an A+ BBB rating and is a NARI of Greater Chicagoland member. Illinois has no statewide general contractor license, so suburban projects are permitted through each village's own building department.
Does Assembly Squad handle HOA and condo building approvals in Chicago?
Yes. Assembly Squad is pre-approved in 300+ Chicago condo buildings and manages the full HOA process on every project, including alteration agreements, certificates of insurance, architectural drawings, neighbor notifications and board presentations. Freight elevator scheduling and building manager coordination are handled by the Assembly Squad team, so owners are not chasing paperwork.
How do I get a remodeling estimate in my area?
Call (312) 544-9150 or request a free in-home consultation online. Assembly Squad visits homes anywhere in Chicago, the North Shore and the listed suburbs, then delivers a fixed-price proposal within 48 hours. Homeowners can also compare finishes and full-size cabinet displays at the Lincoln Park design studio, open by appointment.

Frequently Asked Questions About Chicago Home Remodeling
What makes a good home remodeling blog in Chicago?
+
A good Chicago home remodeling blog should provide local expertise, actual project costs specific to Chicago, neighborhood-specific advice, permit guidance, and insights from experienced local contractors. Assembly Squad's blog offers all this with 500+ completed Chicago projects worth of real experience.
How much does home remodeling cost in Chicago?
+
Chicago home remodeling costs vary by neighborhood and project scope. Kitchen remodels range from $25,000-$100,000+, bathroom renovations from $15,000-$50,000+, and whole-home remodels from $100,000-$500,000+. Costs are typically 15-25% higher than national averages due to Chicago's permitting requirements and skilled labor costs.
Do I need permits for home remodeling in Chicago?
+
Yes, most home remodeling projects in Chicago require permits from the Department of Buildings. This includes kitchen renovations, bathroom remodels, electrical work, plumbing changes, and structural modifications. Processing typically takes 6-10 weeks and costs vary by project scope.
What neighborhoods does Assembly Squad serve in Chicago?
+
Assembly Squad serves all Chicago neighborhoods including Lincoln Park, Lakeview, Logan Square, Wicker Park, Bucktown, River North, Gold Coast, West Loop, Hyde Park, Streeterville, and 40+ other areas throughout the city and nearby suburbs.
How do I choose the best Chicago home remodeling blog?
+
Look for blogs from established Chicago contractors with real project experience, actual cost information, permit guidance, neighborhood-specific advice, and before/after examples. Assembly Squad's blog combines 12+ years of Chicago experience with insights from 500+ completed projects across the city's diverse neighborhoods.

When you search "condo remodeling Chicago" you'll find general contractors who've never navigated a Chicago HOA board, never coordinated a freight elevator, and never dealt with a greystone's galvanized plumbing stack. Assembly Squad is different — we're a true Chicago design-build firm and licensed condo remodeling contractor Chicago owners have trusted since 2013 — with in-house designers, dedicated crews, and deep experience in Gold Coast luxury towers, River North lofts, Lincoln Park greystone conversions, and everything in between.

We know Chicago buildings. We know Chicago HOA boards. And our Illinois-made custom cabinetry ships in 4–6 weeks with zero import tariffs — while other condo renovation companies wait 12–16 weeks for overseas orders that cost you more every month tariffs climb. Our design-build condo Chicago process means one team handles everything: HOA approvals, permits, construction, and final walkthrough.

"We've been inside 300+ Chicago buildings — we know the freight elevator schedule at Marina City, the HOA board at 1 East Delaware, and what it takes to get a permit approved fast at the Department of Buildings. That institutional knowledge is what separates a smooth condo renovation from a nightmare. I built Assembly Squad to be the contractor I'd hire for my own Chicago home."

— VIKTOR AHARON, FOUNDER & CEO, ASSEMBLY SQUAD REMODELING (EST. 2013)

COMMON QUESTIONS
Chicago Condo Remodeling FAQ
How much does condo remodeling cost in Chicago in 2026?
Chicago condo remodeling costs range from $25K–$50K for a kitchen refresh, $50K–$120K for kitchen + primary bathroom, and $100K–$300K+ for a full gut renovation. Costs vary by neighborhood — Gold Coast and River North luxury towers typically run 20–40% higher than Lakeview or South Loop condos. See our complete Chicago condo cost guide 2026 for detailed neighborhood breakdowns.
Do I need HOA approval to remodel my Chicago condo?
Yes — virtually all Chicago condo buildings require HOA or board approval before work begins. This typically includes architectural plans, contractor insurance certificates, an alteration agreement, and sometimes a full board presentation. We handle the entire HOA approval process on every project — you don't deal with the board or management company at all. We're pre-approved in 300+ Chicago buildings. See our complete 2026 condo renovation permission guide for the full HOA and city permit process.
How long does a Chicago condo renovation take?
Construction takes 3–14 weeks depending on scope: bathrooms 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, full gut renovations 10–14 weeks. Add 2–4 weeks for HOA approval prior to start. Chicago Standard Plan Review runs 7–9 weeks — we submit permits on day one so they run concurrently with design and material orders.
What makes Assembly Squad different from other Chicago condo contractors?
Three things nobody else offers: (1) Pre-approved in 300+ buildings — we know the management companies, HOA boards, and building-specific rules before we set foot in your unit. (2) Fixed-price packages — no change orders, no surprises after you sign. (3) A Lincoln Park design studio at 2315 N Southport where you see and touch every cabinet, countertop, and tile before we build. 13 years local, A+ BBB, 500+ projects completed.
Can you remodel a high-rise condo in Chicago?
Yes — high-rise condo remodeling is one of our specialties. We've completed projects in buildings up to 60+ floors across Streeterville, Gold Coast, and River North. We coordinate freight elevators, follow restricted construction hours (typically 8am–5pm weekdays), manage material deliveries, and maintain clean common areas throughout construction.
Can you remodel a greystone or vintage Chicago condo?
Yes — greystone condo and vintage building renovations are a specialty. Lincoln Park greystones, Lakeview 3-flats, and pre-war vintage condos have unique challenges: older galvanized plumbing, knob-and-tube electrical, and narrow stairways for material delivery. We scope all of this in your free consultation so there are zero surprises mid-project.
Do you handle Chicago building permits for condo renovations?
Yes — we handle all permit applications through the City of Chicago Department of Buildings. Most condo kitchen and bathroom renovations require permits for plumbing, electrical, and structural changes. We submit applications, schedule all required inspections, and ensure all work is 100% code-compliant. Permit costs are included in your project estimate.
Does a Chicago condo remodel increase home value?
Yes — Chicago condo renovations return 75–85% ROI in increased home value. Gold Coast, River North, and Lincoln Park condos see the highest returns. A full kitchen + bathroom renovation in a high-rise can add $80K–$150K+ to your resale price depending on the building and finishes.
Can I stay in my condo during the renovation?
Yes — the majority of our condo clients stay in their unit. We set up dust barriers, work within building hours, and keep common areas clean throughout. We recommend staying elsewhere only during demolition (typically days 1–3). For full gut renovations, we work with you to plan a realistic temporary living arrangement if needed.

CHICAGO BASEMENT FAQS
Common Questions Answered

Everything you need to know about basement remodeling in Chicago.

How much does basement remodeling cost in Chicago in 2026?
Chicago basement remodeling typically costs $55-140 per square foot. A 600 sq ft basement costs $35,000-$55,000 for basic finishing, $55,000-$95,000 with bathroom and egress window, and $95,000-$150,000+ for luxury finishes. Chicago costs trend 10-15% higher than national averages.
Can I convert my basement into a rental apartment (ADU) in Chicago?
Yes — under Chicago's citywide ADU ordinance, permit applications opened April 1, 2026, and buildings at least 20 years old in eligible zoning districts can add one basement conversion unit for long-term rental. A basement ADU conversion typically costs $65,000–$120,000 including kitchenette, bathroom, egress, and waterproofing. We handle zoning checks, permits, and construction.
How much does a basement bathroom installation cost in Chicago?
A basement bathroom installation in Chicago typically runs $18,000–$35,000 as an add-on to your overall basement finish, depending on plumbing distance from existing lines and finish level. It includes rough-in plumbing, a shower or tub, tile, and ventilation.
Do you install wet bars as part of a basement remodel?
Yes — a wet bar and entertainment area is one of our most requested basement add-ons, running $12,000–$28,000 on top of the base finish depending on cabinetry, appliances, and tile work. It's designed and built alongside your full basement remodel by one team, not a separate contractor.
Do I need a permit to finish my basement in Chicago?
Yes—Chicago requires building permits for all basement finishing work. Permit costs range from $1,000-$3,000 and take 2-5 weeks to process. We handle all permit applications, drawings, and inspections.
What are Chicago's basement bedroom requirements?
You need an egress window with minimum 5.7 sq ft opening, minimum 20" width and 24" height, maximum 44" sill height, and a window well at least 36" wide if below grade. Installation costs $3,000-$7,000.
How do you handle waterproofing?
We assess every basement and typically install interior drain tile, sump pumps with battery backup, and vapor barriers BEFORE finishing. We also recommend backwater valves to prevent sewer backups.
What is basement build-up and when do I need it?
Basement build-up raises the finished floor level to work around low ceiling heights or plumbing lines, common in older Chicago homes with 6'6"–7' basement clearance. It's evaluated during your free assessment and priced into your overall proposal.
What if my basement has low ceilings?
Chicago code requires 7'0" minimum ceiling height. Options include underpinning ($15,000-$40,000) or creative design solutions. We'll evaluate during your free assessment.
Do you offer basement carpentry without a full remodel?
Most of our basement work is part of a full design-build remodel — framing, trim, and built-ins are handled by our in-house team as one project, not billed as standalone carpentry, so materials and labor stay under one accountable warranty.
How long does a basement remodel take?
Basic finishing: 4-6 weeks. Complete with bathroom: 6-10 weeks. Luxury builds: 10-14 weeks. Add 2-5 weeks for Chicago permits.
What ROI can I expect?
In Chicago, basement finishing delivers 65-70% ROI at resale. A $70,000 remodel can add $45,000-$50,000 in home value.
Are you basement builders near me on the North Shore and in Chicago?
We serve Chicago city neighborhoods (Lincoln Park, Wicker Park, Lakeview, Logan Square, Bucktown, West Loop, Roscoe Village) plus Winnetka, Wilmette, Kenilworth, Glencoe, Highland Park, Lake Forest, Northbrook, Evanston, and Deerfield from our two Chicago locations.
Do you work in the suburbs?
Yes! We serve Oak Park, Evanston, Skokie, Wilmette, and parts of the North Shore. Suburban permits are often faster (1-2 weeks).
